g.text: Marginal effects average over the nine combinations of the other two axes.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #64717d

g.text: Percentage-point differences are used for probabilities. Each comparison uses the neutral level of the same axis as its baseline.
